$comment: Apply-time source patches that expose Spotify internals on the Spicetify global, applied to the xpui-modules.js extracted from the v8 snapshot. Fetched by the CLI through index.json; the CLI embeds a copy as its offline baseline. `replace` is a capture-group template (${0} whole match, ${N} group N; `$$` for a literal dollar). `once` stops after the first match. `onMiss` is `warn` (a miss means a Spotify update moved the code) or `quiet` (a miss is expected on some supported builds). `note` records the measured hit count per build.

patches.name: Redux store
patches.note: 1.2.84: 0, 1.2.96: 1. The store is created inside an IIFE invoked with the session/features/seoExperiment object; this anchors on the only `return (0,createStore)((0,combineReducers)({` in that IIFE and routes the created store through the global. 1.2.84 builds the store another way and has no seoExperiment key at all, so ReduxStore is not exposed there yet.

patches.name: Spotify Image Snackbar Interface
patches.note: 1.2.84: 1, 1.2.96: 1. The enqueue arrow is returned through useCallback rather than assigned.

patches.name: React Component: Navigation for navLinks
patches.note: 1.2.84: 1, 1.2.96: 0. The wrapper finds Navigation through webpack at runtime (react-components.js), so a miss is covered.

patches.name: Flipper components
patches.note: 1.2.84: 1, 1.2.96: 0. react-flip-toolkit left the client in 1.2.9x; nothing remains to expose there.
